title: Sorage Configuration
description: Configuration for Sorage (소라게), the local document handoff and review broker. Every leaf except `installationId` declares its normative fixed default, and `sorage config show --json` on a fresh installation returns the generated installation identifier together with exactly those defaults (CFG-020).

schemaVersion.description: Configuration schema version. Raised only by a schema migration (CFG-001).

configRevision.description: Monotonic revision incremented by every Sorage-mediated write (CFG-002).

installationId.description: Stable installation identity generated by `sorage init` and preserved across `sorage backup restore` (CFG-003, VLT-019). It is the only leaf without a fixed default, because a fresh installation generates a new random UUID.

path.description: Vault directory. Changed only through `sorage vault move --to <path>`, never by editing this file (CFG-013, CFG-014, VLT-001).

importMode.description: The MVP imports Artifacts by copy only (VLT-004).

host.description: Loopback bind address. Only the two loopback literals are accepted; the name `localhost` is rejected because it can resolve off-loopback (SEC-001).

port.description: Daemon port, milestone M2. A change requires a controlled daemon restart (RUN-008), and a bound port fails with PORT_IN_USE (RUN-013).

autoStart.description: Start the daemon automatically where the platform supports it, milestone M2.

openBrowserOnStart.description: Open the Web UI when the daemon starts, milestone M2.

allowUnregisteredSenders.description: Allow an unregistered Workspace to send. Receiving always requires a registered, bound Project (PRJ-013, PRJ-014).

requireRegisteredRecipient.description: A recipient MUST be an active registered Project; this is fixed by PRJ-012 and cannot be turned off.

inboxMarker.description: When true, every Handoff creation or state change rewrites the recipient's derived marker `.sorage/INBOX.md` under each recipient binding directory. The marker is never authoritative. Independently of this key, requested Sorage project setup ensures `.sorage/` is ignored in the Project's `.gitignore` by default, preserving existing entries and avoiding duplicates; the CLI does not automatically edit that file (HND-026).

maxBytes.description: Maximum Artifact size, enforced mid-stream during import and never by buffering the whole body (VLT-015, NFR-005).

externalSourcePolicy.description: `workspace_or_explicit` allows a source outside the resolved sender workspace with `--allow-external-source`; `workspace_only` removes that override (VLT-016).

verifyChecksumOnFetch.description: Re-hash the current Artifact on every fetch. Default false because fetch is the hot read path and re-hashing a 100 MiB Artifact on every call is expensive for a failure mode already covered by `vault verify`, `backup verify`, and the mandatory verification inside revise, accept, backup, and restore (VLT-023). Enable it on installations that store small documents and want immediate detection.

enabled.description: Git backup of the Vault, milestone M3. Off by default so a milestone M1 installation has no Git dependency (BKP-001).

type.description: Only a daily schedule exists in the MVP (BKP-002).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the schedule. The scheduler evaluates the next due run on a 60-second tick in this zone; a local time that does not exist on a DST transition day runs at the next valid instant and a local time that occurs twice runs at its first occurrence (BKP-026).

catchUpAfterMissedRun.description: Run at most one missed backup after a daemon start; repeated missed intervals never produce a burst (BKP-015).

enabled.description: Remote push, toggled by `sorage backup enable-push` and `sorage backup disable-push` (BKP-011, BKP-025).

remote.description: Git remote name for the push.

branch.description: Git branch for the push; only a fast-forward `git push --atomic` is permitted (BKP-013, BKP-014).

largeArtifactWarningBytes.description: Import prints a warning above this size while Git backup is enabled, because Git history keeps every committed revision of the file forever.

redactWorkspacePaths.description: Redact local filesystem paths from the exported snapshots. When true, `senderPathSnapshot`, Project Binding paths, and path fields inside event `metadataJson` are redacted, and `sorage backup restore` rebuilds the ledger exactly as exported rather than reconstructing the removed paths.

defaultPageSize.description: Default cursor page size for CLI and Web lists.

showArchivedByDefault.description: Include archived Handoffs in default listings, the equivalent of `--include-archived` (LIFE-009).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for rendering timestamps. Null means the system timezone. Timestamps are always stored in UTC (NFR-007).

level.description: Structured JSON log level for every Sorage process. The default `warn` keeps a CLI invocation quiet (RUN-009).

includeFullPaths.description: Log full filesystem paths. False redacts paths while retaining stable identifiers (SEC-011).

maxBytes.description: Rotate `~/.sorage/logs/sorage.log` once it reaches this size (RUN-009).

maxFiles.description: Number of rotated log files retained.

graceHours.description: Age before an unreferenced file under `artifacts/` or an entry under `staging/` may be swept. Garbage collection runs only after the pending intent drain and never deletes a path matching any storageKey or any pending intent (VLT-013, VLT-014).
